items.text: On wards 7A and 7B, will a protected night repositioning round with risk reassessment at the evening handover, tested in PDSA cycles from November 2026 to April 2027, increase the median number of patient-days between category 2 or worse pressure injuries found at weekly skin inspection by at least half compared with the baseline year?
items.population: Adult inpatients at high risk of pressure injury on wards 7A and 7B
items.intervention: Protected night repositioning round at fixed times, float nurse when the ratio is worse than one to seven, and handover risk reassessment
items.outcome: Patient-days between category 2 or worse injuries found at weekly inspection
items.time: Baseline year, then six months of PDSA cycles

finer: Feasible within existing staff and the night bank; interesting to the board; novel locally; ethical under registration QI-2026-054; relevant because injuries follow busy nights.
summary: One SMART QI aim with an interval measure suited to rare events.
